scores.note: One university radio network, but its random-access channel sharing fed Ethernet and later wireless protocols; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
One release event that let the existing Web software spread across the Internet; the Web's wider reach is shared with its invention and later browsers.
One experimental site network whose design became the standard local network worldwide; a cheaper, faster way to link computers that were already being networked.
Solid-state electronic imaging spread through cameras, scanners and astronomy in many societies and founded digital imaging, later largely displaced by CMOS sensors.
One product model that brought a more reliable transistor to electronics makers, with a few direct successors.
First solid-state amplification, a new capability from which semiconductor device work grew; this superseded device itself saw only limited professional use.
Transistor making was reorganised around the planar structure, and integrated circuits, hence most later electronics and computing, stand on it.
The MOS transistor is in nearly every chip most of humanity now carries or relies on, and unrelated fields stand on it as a platform.
A finding used by the semiconductor profession that made stable silicon devices possible; MOS and planar device work grew from it.
A patterning step within oxide-masked diffusion that device manufacture was reorganised around; the chip lithography line grew from it within one profession.
One recorded idea inside one firm, a refinement of existing oxide practice, from which the planar transistor and integrated-circuit line followed.
Gave the semiconductor profession the ability to confine dopants to chosen areas; patterned diffusion and planar manufacture grew from it.
An explanation used by semiconductor physicists that redirected work toward surfaces, leading to the transistor and passivation; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
A cleaner, more robust recovery method within existing logged recovery, adopted by database builders with direct variants; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
One system configuration at one institute that showed interactive shared computing with files, from which the time-sharing operating system line descended across the profession.
One compiler for one machine, yet scientific programming was reorganised around formula languages and the compiler and language field grew from it.
A better way to plan relational queries, used by database builders; cost-based query optimisation grew from it as a line of work; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One product that gave business computing direct access to any stored record, a new capability; the magnetic disk storage line grew from it.
One tape drive model improving on existing computer tape storage, followed by improved versions of itself; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
Rewritable non-volatile chip memory was new for engineers across the electronics profession, and the floating-gate memory line through flash grew from it.
A working-fluid step that made existing compression refrigeration reliable for ice, brewing and cold storage in many societies; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
Artificial cold on demand was a new capability; refrigerators and cold chains built on this cycle now serve most of humanity, and refrigeration engineering grew from it.
One trial that showed electrical engineers efficient long-distance transmission was possible; three-phase power systems were then built on its pattern.
One installation that gave a region bulk power from a distant waterfall, with direct successors elsewhere; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
One station serving one city district that showed electricity sold as a utility service; the central-station industry in many cities followed its model.
A new energy source and capability; power reactors, weapons, naval propulsion, isotope medicine and neutron science across many societies all rest on it.
One engine draining one colliery with less coal, followed directly by later Boulton & Watt engines; implies tier 3, well below the reviewed tier 1.
One patent text describing a clear improvement to engine working, known to the engine trade, with a few direct successors.
A late copy of a long-known engine type serving one colliery, with nothing later resting on it; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
One patent text setting out a fuel-saving refinement known to the engine trade, with a few successors including Carnot's use of its example.
Working power from steam drained mines across Britain and Europe and the steam engine line grew from it; importance.md anchors generativity at 2, implying tier 1 not 0.
One engine keeping one works' waterwheel turning, with some lessons carried into later engines; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
One small engine supplementing one cotton mill's power, an early example followed by other steam-driven mills; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
One patent text that fixed and protected an existing improvement for the engine trade, with a few later specifications and engines drawing on it.
One waterworks engine applying early steam cutoff, a modest fuel saving at one site, directly followed by the 1782 specification.
One prototype at one works that first delivered smooth rotary steam power to machinery, followed by improved rotative engines; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
A variant two-cylinder arrangement used at one works, not taken up; later compound engines are not known to rest on it.
One rebuilt experimental engine tested at one works, confirming an improvement and leading directly to the first commercial engines; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
Electricity generation and ship propulsion were reorganised around the multistage turbine across many societies, and turbomachinery engineering grew from it.
One patent text for a gearing that worked around the crank patent, used by the engine trade for some years before being superseded.
An improvement so large that steam power was reorganised around it across Britain, Europe and America; the Watt engine line grew from it.
A lighter, denser rechargeable cell now carried by most of humanity in phones; portable electronics and electric-vehicle battery work grew from it.
One variant of a known battery in one laboratory, notable only because a single later experiment relied on its current.
Steady electric current was a new capability; electrochemistry, electromagnetism, telegraphy and later electrical technology in many societies all stood on it.
Self-acting water lifting eased irrigation for river communities across the Mediterranean and Middle East for centuries, with few known successors; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One siege expedient that kept a city's existing milling going, with later river boat mills as successors; implies tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
A staple crop that changed how people fed themselves, now eaten or fed to livestock worldwide; American civilisations and much later agriculture rested on it.
One pond among many supplying one community with managed fish, with nothing later known to rest on it; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
Made secure sea-mammal hunting possible for several coastal peoples, a small share of humanity, with later harpoon forms as successors; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Walls added to improve one existing fish-trap channel for one community, with no known successors; implies tier 3, well below the reviewed tier 1.
One cut channel that gave one community engineered fish trapping, a new capability for them, with later walls built onto it.
